title: QoS panel per-direction depth readout (fwd/rev columns) has no automated coverage — no unit test, not in any golden capture
detail: S5's T2 disclosure says zero golden drift — panels are off in captures. Reading the wrong direction, or column overflow at UI scales (the r3 precedent class), passes every gate. Core read itself is pinned.
recommended_fix: Add a geometry test for the depth row (six columns + two dir labels fit the panel at every UI_SCALE_STEPS), mirroring the nudge-rect pin.

title: NOC QUEUE row draw re-key (R<router>><peer> label, per-port lanes) untested — only the noc_queue_rows predicate has a test
evidence: draw_mono_c(v, fmt.tprintf("R%d>%d", pr.router, pr.peer), px + 6, ty, NOC_SIZE_BODY, NOC_TXT_DIM) — the only ports-based test pins the predicate alone (noc_overlay_test.odin:318-322): append(&sr.ports, pp.Stats_Port_Row{router = 1, peer = 2, q = {0, 0, 0}, util_pct = 69}) ... testing.expect_value(t, noc_queue_rows(&sr, 70), i32(2)); the draw loop and label format have no test, and the overlay-check verb is PP_DEBUG-only (harness/main.odin:257 'the verb stays a PP_DEBUG harness tool').
detail: The row re-key is draw-only and outside the gating suite; a regression (wrong router/peer mapping, lane bars reading the wrong port) passes lint, odin test app/render, and T1/T2.
recommended_fix: Extract the row-label/mapping into a pure proc (stats.ports row -> label string) and pin it; or add the QUEUE section to a PP_DEBUG overlay-check sidecar and re-bless it.

title: Lint gate 8 (link-queue vocabulary) deviates from its cited LB-gate precedent: Ada_Case names bypass, comments false-positive, no negative self-test
evidence: HITS=$(grep -rnE 'link_(queue|depth|backlog|buffer|load|congest)' app/ --include='*.odin' || true) — vs the precedent at lines 35/39: LB_PAT='pick_pipe|lb_mode|lb_weighted|node_lb_weighted|Lb_Mode|load[ _-]?balanc|round[ _-]?robin' and _found=$(sed 's://.*::' "$_f" | grep -nE "$LB_PAT" ...). Verified empirically: 'Link_Queue_Depth' gets 0 matches from the gate-8 regex (bypass); a comment '// no link_queue concept (spine)' matches (no comment stripping); gates 7/7b carry python self-tests, gate 8 has none.
detail: The gate works for snake_case drift (verified: link_queue_depth matches) but a future Link_Queue type or a spine-quoting comment bends it either way; gates 7/7b set the self-test bar this gate skips.
recommended_fix: Match the LB-gate shape: strip comments (sed), add Link_ variants (Ada_Case), and add a one-line negative self-test asserting the pattern catches a known-bad string.
